subject: general
question: The Union Government has appointed ______ as the chairperson of an empowered committee for the administration of Covid-19 vaccine.
solution:
The correct answer is __**R S Sharma**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **R S Sharma** has been appointed as the chairperson of an empowered committee for the administration of the Covid-19 vaccine by the Union Government.
 
• R S Sharma is the former chairman of the **Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI)**.
 
• His appointment aims to streamline and oversee the effective distribution and administration of the Covid-19 vaccine across the country.
 
• This committee will play a crucial role in ensuring that the vaccine reaches all eligible beneficiaries in a systematic and organized manner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Covid-19 vaccination drive** in India is one of the largest in the world, targeting a population of over 1.3 billion people.
 
• The Union Government has also launched the **Co-WIN platform** to manage and monitor the vaccination process.
 
• India has approved several Covid-19 vaccines for emergency use, including **COVAXIN, Covishield, and Sputnik V**.
 
• The vaccination drive is being conducted in phases, prioritizing healthcare workers, frontline workers, and vulnerable populations.
 
• Public awareness and cooperation are essential for the successful implementation of the vaccination program.
 
• The government is also working on addressing vaccine hesitancy and ensuring equitable access to vaccines for all citizens.
